title: Evaluation under dualization
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs in which every NOT gate has exactly one argument. For every input assignment $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, the dual circuit evaluated on the bitwise complement of $x$ outputs the complement of the output of $C$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs
Every NOT gate in C has exactly one argument
